title: Flash floods hit Brunei-Muara and Tutong villages
detail: Prolonged heavy rain on Jan 7-8 caused rapid flooding of roads and homes in several Brunei-Muara mukims (Gadong, Berakas, Kilanas, Kota Batu, Kianggeh, Pengkalan Batu) and Tutong villages incl. Birau, Kebia and Bekiau; a vehicle was submerged on Jalan Aman, Berakas B. BDMD said wet conditions would persist to Jan 12.
attribution: BDMD advisories via Borneo Bulletin/ANN (The Star)

title: Rain-triggered landslide at Tutong cemetery
detail: Persistent heavy rain caused a landslide at the Luagan Kelupang Muslim cemetery in Kampong Sinaut; FRD, NDMC, the district office and Public Works inspected and covered the slope with canvas. No casualties reported.
attribution: Ministry of Religious Affairs via Borneo Bulletin/ANN (The Star)

title: Flooding slows Muara-Tutong Highway traffic
detail: Floodwater on sections of the Muara-Tutong Highway near Kampong Keriam caused long queues between Tutong and Brunei-Muara; a red weather advisory had been issued the night before for Belait, Tutong and western Brunei-Muara.
attribution: Motorist accounts and weather advisory via Borneo Bulletin/ANN (The Star)

title: Landslide severs main pipeline; Brunei-Muara water cut
detail: Public Works Department said a landslide at Batang Mitus, Tutong, damaged 16 sections of a main water pipeline, disrupting supply to Berakas, Gadong, Kota Batu, Kilanas, Kianggeh and Pangkalan Batu; clinics limited to urgent cases, some private schools closed, and water tanks deployed. Full restoration expected around Feb 2.

title: Central bank warns against unlicensed financial providers
detail: BDCB warned the public to deal only with licensed institutions, saying unlicensed entities increasingly advertise deposit-taking, lending, investment and remittance services on Facebook, Instagram, Telegram and WhatsApp.

title: Cable theft blamed for power disruptions
detail: Department of Electrical Services said outages on Mar 17 and 19 affecting Kampong Kasat, Kampong Sungai Liang, Mukim Seria and Kampong Kiarong followed damage to underground cables and equipment in attempted thefts; it warned such tampering carries 3-10 years' jail and caning.
place: Kampong Kasat, Sungai Liang, Seria, Kiarong

title: Highway cycling ban planned after cyclist deaths
detail: After two cyclist deaths and one hospitalisation in separate crashes over the previous month, the development minister outlined plans to ban cycling on highways and roads above 65 km/h (nine named roads incl. Muara-Belait Highway) and designate district cycling routes.
attribution: Minister of Development via The Scoop

title: Royal Brunei Airlines extends Dubai suspension
detail: Royal Brunei Airlines extended its suspension of Bandar Seri Begawan-Dubai flights until Jul 2, citing regional conflict and Gulf airspace closures, while keeping three weekly direct London flights.
attribution: Royal Brunei Airlines notice via TTR Weekly

title: Impersonation-scam 'runner' arrested
detail: RBPF arrested a 23-year-old foreign national suspected of collecting cash from victims who were threatened by syndicate members posing as government officers by phone; phones, a tablet and a vehicle were seized.

title: Heat drives surge in forest and bush fires
detail: FRD recorded 125 forest and 81 bush fires (about 415.5 ha) from Jan 26 to Apr 26, 88 forest fires in April alone; blazes near Universiti Teknologi Brunei (~28 ha, Apr 25) and RPN Kampong Rimba (~20 ha, Apr 26) needed RBAF water-bombing via NDMC.

title: 7-hectare fire at Berakas Forest Reserve
detail: A fire spreading in patches over hilly terrain burned about 7 ha of government land at the Berakas Forest Reserve recreational park; FRD sent four engines and 32 personnel. No injuries.

title: MoH: no hantavirus cases, risk low
detail: The Ministry of Health said Brunei had no hantavirus cases and low risk amid the MV Hondius cruise-linked cluster, advising travellers from affected areas with fever or respiratory symptoms to seek care.

title: High Court forfeits drug-syndicate assets
detail: On an NCB application, the High Court forfeited BND143,274.40 in cash, gold jewellery and vehicles from a couple linked to a family-run methamphetamine trafficking ring ('Musang King') arrested in 2020.

title: MoH rates Bundibugyo Ebola risk low
detail: MoH said the risk of Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) reaching Brunei is low and advised against non-essential travel to affected areas of DR Congo and Uganda, following WHO's PHEIC declaration.

title: Southwest monsoon begins; drier months forecast
detail: BDMD said the southwest monsoon (May-Sep) would bring more stable, possibly drier-than-normal weather, with August forecast at 140 mm or less; it cited a 92% chance of El Nino conditions.

title: 'BTC 800 Lurotix' added to BDCB Alert List
detail: BDCB added 'BTC 800 Lurotix' to its Alert List of unlicensed entities over suspicious activities and warned of scammers misusing the central bank's name and logo.

title: Malaysian jailed over cross-border ATM fraud
detail: A Malaysian man was jailed 6 years 8 months under the Computer Misuse Act for collecting debit cards in Brunei for accomplices' unauthorised ATM withdrawals on instruction from a Malaysia-based handler; losses BND8,480.

title: House fire kills girl in Seria
detail: A night fire gutted a wooden house in Seria and spread to an adjacent structure; a 9-year-old girl died and a 72-year-old suffered burns. FRD controlled it within an hour; cause under investigation.

title: Multi-agency operation in Bandar Seri Begawan
detail: Over 200 officers from RBPF, immigration, NCB, customs, labour and others checked two sites; two foreigners were held under the Immigration Act and labour/electricity breaches recorded. A trafficking unit interviewed 19 people and found no trafficking offences.

title: Chinese navy ships make port call at Muara
detail: PLA Navy training ship Qi Jiguang and landing ship Kunlunshan made a five-day goodwill visit (Jul 24-28) to Muara port, with public tours offered.

title: Belait joint operation: two held for drugs
detail: A 59-strong RBPF-led operation with NCB, customs and immigration in Kuala Belait detained two men on suspected drug offences; customs recorded 14 offences involving 12 people and seized 73 cigarette packets and a vape.
place: Jalan Kuala Balai / Jalan Pandan 5, Kuala Belait

title: Six foreigners detained in Seria immigration check
detail: Immigration (INRD) Operasi Kakas 79/2026 inspected 16 foreign nationals in Seria and detained six: five for working for employers not on their permits and one for overstaying.

title: Police warn of fake 'investigation notice' scam
detail: RBPF warned that fraudsters are sending forged 'Notice of Involvement in Investigation' letters and fake warrant cards impersonating its Cyber Crime Investigation Division and Interpol to extract money or bank details.

title: 14 straight days of excessive heat; 38.2C at Labi
detail: BDMD said Aug 8-21 brought 14 consecutive days of excessive heat, peaking at 38.2C at Labi (Anggerek Desa 37.5C); August rain to date was about 51% below normal and maxima of 33-36C were expected to continue.

title: 15 foreigners held in Operasi Kakas checks
detail: INRD reported four operations in Mukim Sengkurong and Berakas A/B inspecting 28 foreign nationals and detaining 15 for working on visit passes, overstaying or not working for their original employer.

title: Haze arrives; MoH advises vulnerable groups
detail: MoH, with BDMD, advised vulnerable groups to limit outdoor activity as smoke from 1,180-1,734 daily Borneo hotspots drifted in; PSI on Aug 30 was moderate (Brunei-Muara 73, Tutong 70).

title: HFM-linked entity added to BDCB Alert List
detail: BDCB added 'Goldpecker Community/HF Markets/HFM' to its Alert List for investment-related activity without BDCB licence.

title: MoH issues haze health advisory
detail: Following a joint ministerial statement, MoH warned haze can worsen asthma and heart and lung disease, and advised limiting time outdoors, well-fitted masks and HEPA purifiers.

title: Haze: Brunei-Muara PSI 116
detail: JASTRe's 09:00 PSI was unhealthy in Brunei-Muara (116) and Belait (107); PM2.5 was added to the PSI from Sep 1.
agency: Department of Environment, Parks and Recreation (JASTRe)

title: Belait PSI climbs to 152
detail: JASTRe said Belait's PSI rose from 113 at 11:00 to 152 (unhealthy) at 16:00; Brunei-Muara was 107.
agency: Department of Environment, Parks and Recreation (JASTRe)

title: Customs seize 4.25 kg of drugs at border posts
detail: Royal Customs and Excise said checks near control posts seized 4,254.32 g of controlled drugs plus beer, liquor and 200 cigarette packets; four Bruneians were detained.

title: Haze returns to unhealthy in two districts
detail: JASTRe's 09:00 PSI was 118 in Belait and 113 in Brunei-Muara (unhealthy); Tutong had hit 104 at 07:00.
agency: Department of Environment, Parks and Recreation (JASTRe)

title: Record vape-possession fine of BND465,898
detail: A Malaysian was fined a total of BND465,898 under the Excise Order for possessing over 1,000 vape devices, 3,121 bottles of vape juice and accessories seized by customs at Kampong Sungai Tilong in 2023; goods forfeited.
